decisions.text: type stacked_bar_100: how the fractions of the total change, the total itself not needed: 100 % stacks, bars, the particular periods being the point (G1.44, G1.45)
scale 0–100 by 20: each total 100 %, its parts in % of it (R7-30, G7.32)
stacking order from the base: East, West, South, North (the largest at the base, where it is read precisely; G7.31, D-26 (b))
each part in one colour and one place in every total: East (slot 1), West (slot 2), South (slot 4), North (slot 3) (G4.22, G7.31)
time axis: row 2 (“2022”) left out, the title gives it (G2.37)
the unit's description on its own line above the scale (inline it would meet the stacked bar of 2022-01): “Share of total donations”; “100%” stays on the top label
each part named beside the last stack, level with the middle of its segment, top to bottom as stacked: North, South, West, East (G5.4, D-31 (c))
the title wraps onto two lines

source.shows: the same for particular months: 100 % stacked bars (R7-30, R7-28, G1.45); each region in the colour it has in all six charts of 07 #14 (fixed slots, the book's: East blue, West orange, North olive, South gold; R3-24, G4.22, D-22 (a))
